title: Pan-Seared Fish with Jamaican Spice Crust
description: A flavorful and moist fish dish with a crunchy Jamaican spice crust. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Mix the Jamaican Spice Mix and crispy oatmeal together in a shallow dish.
Dip each fish fillet into the spice mix and coat evenly.
Heat the Tagine Olive Oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the fish fillets in the skillet for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Sprinkle the almond meal over the fish and return to the oven for an additional 2 minutes.
